events.title: HOME · Sean · Morning reset + slow cooker
events.notes: Office day. Unload dishwasher. Start the slow cooker (or pull leftovers to thaw). Coffee made before you leave.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Morning reset
events.notes:
Unload dishwasher, coffee + breakfast out for her.
Tue: start laundry load (hers + shared).
Fri: strip beds, start sheets + towels.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Laundry to dryer + quick pickup
events.notes: Lunch break. Wash to dryer. 10-minute pickup of the living room.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Vacuum + grocery order
events.notes: She's at the library: go loud. Vacuum every floor. Then place the grocery order for Thursday 5 PM pickup.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Kitchen deep wipe + fridge cleanout
events.notes: Toss old leftovers before trash night. Wipe microwave, stovetop, fridge shelves.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Sheets to dryer (quietly)
events.notes: She's studying at home. Quiet chores only. On in-office Fridays this moves to 5 PM.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Fold + put away laundry
events.notes: Before she gets home. She shouldn't walk in to a pile.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Grocery pickup + put away
HOME · Sean · Fold sheets + make beds
events.notes: Her 5 PM check-in is happening. Keep it quiet. In-office Fridays: dryer at 5, fold at 6.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Cook dinner
events.notes: Dinner on the table by 6:15. Wed: daughter cooks with you if she's home.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Dinner (slow cooker / leftovers)
HOME · Sean · Easy Friday dinner
events.notes: Takeout or something simple. Her week is done when the check-in is.

events.title: HOME · Sean + daughter · Week huddle
events.notes: Get her schedule for the week. Anything she can't cover, you take or you swap. Write it on the fridge chart.

events.title: HOME · Sean · Pack her bag for tomorrow
events.notes: Lunch, snacks, water bottle, headphones, laptop charger. Tue = Forum, Wed/Thu = library.

events.title: HOME · Daughter · Mon chores
events.notes:
Any time before 8 PM.
- Kitchen close after dinner (load + run dishwasher, wipe counters, sweep)
- Empty every small trash can into the big bin
- Mom studies at home 9:30 to 5: quiet house
Schedule clash? Swap it with Dad at Monday huddle.

events.title: HOME · Daughter · Tue chores
events.notes:
Any time before 8 PM.
- Kitchen close after dinner
- Set the table before dinner
- Wipe down the dining table + coffee table
Schedule clash? Swap it with Dad at Monday huddle.

events.title: HOME · Daughter · Wed chores
events.notes:
Any time before 8 PM.
- Kitchen close after dinner
- Your own laundry, start to finish
- Help cook dinner if you're home
Schedule clash? Swap it with Dad at Monday huddle.

events.title: HOME · Daughter · Thu chores
events.notes:
Any time before 8 PM.
- Kitchen close after dinner
- Bathrooms: toilet, sink, mirror, fresh towels
- Trash + recycling to the curb
Schedule clash? Swap it with Dad at Monday huddle.

events.title: HOME · Daughter · Fri chores
events.notes:
Any time before 8 PM.
- Kitchen close after dinner
- Reset shared spaces for the weekend (shoes, bags, blankets)
- Mom studies at home till 5:30: quiet house
Schedule clash? Swap it with Dad at Monday huddle.

events.title: HOME · Thanksgiving half day
events.notes: She studies 9:30 to 12:30. House stays quiet till then. Nobody asks her to cook.

events.title: HOME · Check in with her: still feeling good about Feb?
events.notes: Last day for the 60% exam refund. Just ask how she's doing. No pressure either way.

events.title: HOME · SIM MBE DAY: her pick for dinner

events.title: HOME · SIM WRITTEN DAY: her pick for dinner
